name: team_planning_set_scenario_period
description: Move the end of a 'then' scenario in a Team Planning plan. Every step after it starts the day after the new end, and its alternatives take the new period. The first step after the baseline may also move its start with starts_on, on or after the plan's base date; the days before it read as today. A later step's start follows the step before it, so starts_on is refused for one unless it repeats that start. Refused if a later step would end before it starts, naming that step, if someone's last day would fall outside the scenario they leave in, or unless the caller is an editor.
